verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training privacy posture is a fair question for an authentication product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no Better Auth policy, setting or statement on AI model training or opting out of it. Community remarks that users keep their auth data in their own database are adjacent (self-hosted data ownership), not a documented training opt-out, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
